metaDescription: Kevin launches his Discord and kevinisahuman.com, rants about Stew Peters' Charlie Kirk graphic, and reacts to Upper Echelon's Black October PHP video.
summary: This livestream covers Kevin's launch of a new Discord community and website, his response to being included in a Stew Peters graphic, and a watch-along of Upper Echelon's video on "Black October." Kevin describes the Discord's free and $3-a-month tiers and promotes kevinisahuman.com as a topic-organized hub built for SEO and GEO. He denies any involvement in Charlie Kirk coverage and rejects Peters' "Fed" accusations against Danks. He then plays Upper Echelon's video, which argues the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities were real but marketed by OpenAI, Wiz, and Google. Kevin agrees the event looks manufactured.
